title: $\ell$BISG: Probabilistic Race and Ethnicity Prediction Using Group-Specific Name Lists
abstract: arXiv:2610.06273v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Statistically valid estimation of racial and ethnic disparities often requires inferring group membership probabilities from names and geographic locations. The standard method, Bayesian Improved Surname Geocoding (BISG), requires group frequencies for each name. Such data are available from the U.S. Census Bureau for common names and limited racial categories, but are unavailable for many ethnic groups and rarely exist outside the United States. We propose list-powered BISG ($\ell$BISG), in which we replace these frequencies with group-specific name lists and combine the lists with geographic prevalence data to obtain calibrated group membership probabilities. These lists can be compiled from different sources or generated by large language models (LLMs), despite potentially unknown biases. translated_title: ℓBISG：利用特定群体姓名列表进行种族和民族的概率预测
translated_abstract: 统计学上有效的种族和民族差异估计通常需要从姓名和地理位置推断群体归属概率。标准方法是贝叶斯改进姓氏地理编码，该方法需要每个姓名的群体频率数据。这类数据可从美国人口普查局获得，但仅限于常见姓名和有限的种族类别，对许多族裔群体则无法获得，且在美国之外极少存在。我们提出列表驱动的BISG方法（ℓBISG），用特定群体的姓名列表替代这些频率数据，并将姓名列表与地理流行度数据相结合，以获得经过校准的群体归属概率。这些姓名列表可以从不同来源汇编，或由大型语言模型（LLMs）生成，尽管可能存在未知的偏差。在满足关于姓名列表的一定条件下，ℓBISG还可以在没有地理流行度数据的情况下应用。使用美国数据进行的实证验证（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出改进方法ℓBISG，用特定群体姓名列表（可由大语言模型生成）替代传统BISG所需的姓名频率数据，结合地理信息实现种族和民族归属概率的校准预测，即使在没有普查频率数据或地理数据的情况下也能应用。
en_tdlr: We propose ℓBISG, which replaces census-based name frequency data in BISG with group-specific name lists (potentially generated by LLMs) combined with geographic prevalence data, enabling calibrated race and ethnicity probability prediction even when such frequency data are unavailable or geography data are absent.
